githubDescription:
SakuraCord v0.1.7 Beta 5 adds thread creation, a Threads browser and thread actions in side chats, a rebuilt forum browser, and Discord security checks across the app. It also brings forum and thread unread tracking in line with Discord, smooths side-chat and member-list motion, and fixes several friends and messaging issues.

## Threads and side chats

- Added Create Thread to the message context menu, with a starter-message preview and an optional name, and View Thread when a message already has one.
- Added a Threads browser for text and announcement channels that lists joined and active threads, loads older threads as you scroll and supports search.
- Added Join and Leave Thread, Follow and Unfollow Post, and renaming threads and posts from the side chat menu, with renames from other clients appearing live.
- Fixed open threads and forum posts closing on their own, unreliable thread navigation, gaps in thread history, duplicated NEW dividers and thread links showing as “unknown-post”.
- Changed the member list and search results to close a side chat when they open beside it, and improved side-chat toolbars and timeline thread cards.

## Forums

- Rebuilt the forum browser on a native card board, so cards no longer resize or jump while loading and scrolling is smoother.
- Added per-forum memory of sort order, view and tag matching, plus scroll position within a session.
- Added a divider between a post's original message and its replies, and simplified post reactions to the emoji and count.
- Fixed mention pills shrinking, text ghosting and the list jumping as posts open and close, and a blank list after filtering while scrolled down.

## Unread tracking

- Improved forum and thread read state to follow Discord's rules for New labels, the sidebar new-post count, Mark as Read and Mark Unread, including posts made before you joined a server.
- Changed thread mentions to count toward server badges only for joined, active threads.
- Added a clickable new-messages banner that jumps to your first unread message, and separated Scroll to bottom from New messages.
- Fixed the NEW divider appearing for messages that arrive while you are at the bottom, and unread indicators lingering while you scroll through new messages.

## Security checks, friends and messages

- Added Discord's security check (CAPTCHA) to any request Discord challenges, replaying the request once it is solved. Closing the check on a friend request now ends quietly.
- Added Close DM to direct message context menus, and made Add Friend from profiles, DMs and menus send the request directly with clearer error messages.
- Added Discord's explanation to messages blocked by AutoMod, which can no longer be retried.
- Improved account switching to return to each account's last conversation.
- Raised the Nitro upload limit to 1 GB.

## Motion and layout

- Improved side-chat and member-list motion so it stays smooth on lower-memory Macs, and stopped the timeline stretching while the member list opens or closes.
- Improved toolbar buttons, loading skeletons and the labels of motion settings.

**Full Changelog:** [v0.1.7-Beta-4...v0.1.7-Beta-5](https://github.com/SakuraCordApp/SakuraCord/compare/v0.1.7-Beta-4...v0.1.7-Beta-5)
discordAnnouncement:
**Thread creation, a rebuilt forum browser and security checks 🌙**

**Highlights**
- Start threads from any message, browse a channel's threads, and join, follow or rename them right in the side chat
- Forums load on a smoother card board and remember each forum's sort and view
- New labels, unread counts and Mark as Read for forums and threads now follow Discord's rules
- Discord's security checks now appear wherever Discord asks for one, instead of the request just failing
- Side chats and the member list move smoothly, and the new-messages banner jumps to your first unread
- Close DM, one-click Add Friend from profiles, and 1 GB Nitro uploads
